fixes.where: index.html / weddings.html / about.html: every pom-tree-night srcset
fixes.what: Drop the 'pom-tree-night-1400.jpg 1400w' candidate (or regenerate the master at ≥1400w). The master is 1125w, so the 1400 file is an upscale and at 225 KB it is heavier than the 192 KB master; 2x phones and the 60vw accordion slot pick it.
fixes.why: srcset descriptors must be true pixel widths or the browser downloads a blurrier, heavier file

fixes.what: Remove the ScrollTrigger.refresh() call from settle(); the ResizeObserver on the accordion already refreshes (debounced 150 ms) whenever the row height changes.
fixes.why: a fast mouse sweep across six strips fires open()/settle() six times and each one does a full ScrollTrigger.refresh (layout of every trigger on the page) on top of the observer's refresh

fixes.where: site.js: the two window 'scroll' listeners (onScrollState and the tab block)
fixes.what: Merge them into one listener gated by a requestAnimationFrame flag, and only write classList/aria/tabIndex when the computed value changed.
fixes.why: with Lenis every frame is a scroll event; syncTab currently writes four attributes on two fixed elements per event, which forces style recalcs under the backdrop-filtered header

fixes.what: Drop backdrop-filter:blur(8px) on the fixed header or limit it to (min-width:769px) and (hover:hover); keep the .96 cypress fill.
fixes.why: a fixed element with a backdrop filter is re-composited on every scrolled frame; on mid-range phones it is the single biggest frame-time cost on a page that also scrubs the hero and trunks

fixes.what: Make it 12px minimum (or hide it under 480px and rely on the visually-hidden '(Persian site, coming soon)').
fixes.why: 10 px text is below any legible floor and it is the only cue that the word is not a live switch

fixes.what: Remove the permanent 52px indent; the fixed Pause button only overlaps that line at the bottom of the viewport. If clearance is needed, add 56px of bottom padding to .inquire__contact's parent instead (as the form already does).
fixes.why: the contact line is the only block on the page that does not start at the card edge, and the reason is invisible to the reader
